_provenance: Task 2173 vectors for beebeeb_core::direct_transfer::upload: the grant and commit answer parsers, the init transport rule and the per-chunk retry policy. Hand-authored from the spec (R1.1, R1.6, R2.4, R2.6, R3.4) and the merged server's real bodies (server main 30c8ed62, routes/direct_transfer.rs). Read by the core tests in upload.rs ONLY (exact row counts); the WASM and UniFFI exports do not load it (they take the parsers and the policy when web/mobile ship uploads). The 'classify' rows for the upload calls live in direct_transfer.json and ARE run by core, the WASM seams and the UniFFI exports. Every row has a `source` (a server file:line at 30c8ed62, a spec rule, or 'client policy' / 'client-side case' / 'synthetic'). Regenerate with test-vectors/tools/make_direct_upload_vectors.py; the jittered waits come from test-vectors/tools/jitter_port.py.

constants.upload_lease_seconds_source: server 30c8ed62 beebeeb-api/src/upload_lease.rs:151 (DEFAULT_LEASE_SECS); min_uplink_bps_for_chunk() at :248 = ceil(chunk_bytes * 8 / lease_secs), applied to the largest chunk by direct_transfer.rs:424-429 (min_uplink_bps)
